trap.label: causativa
trap.wrong: I’m cutting my hair at the salon.
trap.right: I’m getting my hair cut at the salon.
trap.why: O brasileiro diz “estou cortando meu cabelo” mesmo quando outro corta. Em inglês, get/have + objeto + particípio.

fix.wrong: She is getting cut her hair.
fix.right: She is getting her hair cut.

fix.wrong: I cut my hair at the salon yesterday.
fix.right: I had my hair cut at the salon yesterday.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva: “A barber is cutting my hair.” (I’m getting…)

rewrite.answer: I didn’t have my hair cut.
